title: History, correction and deletion
brief: Represent agreements and changing facts with explicit effective and recorded times. Carry corrections, retention and deletion through related and external records without rewriting the meaning of historical purchases.

neighbouring_ownership.data-modelling: Owns first current-price versus agreed-price distinction.
neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns restoring an earlier database history and reconciling valid work.

title: Storage and durability
brief: Connect logical updates to pages, buffers, retained row versions and cleanup, distinguishing reusable space, file shrinkage and write amplification. Explain write-ahead ordering, commit durability and restart recovery, and separate them from recovery after lost storage or an unwanted committed change.

neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns restorable history and recovery reconciliation.
neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns copied history, progress and read routing.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns native retention diagnosis and transaction age.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns native settings and crash drills.

title: Failover and fencing
brief: Distinguish suspected failure from authority to write. Fence a former writer, choose a promotion point with an explicit loss boundary, reconcile divergence and rejoin safely.

neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns replicated membership and planned data movement, not primary/standby promotion.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns native physical promotion and return.

title: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
brief: Build and test a base-backup and archived-WAL chain, restore a verified target and account for valid work outside the recovered history. Close source writes before reconciliation and preserve external-effect identity.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns promoting an existing physical copy.

title: CockroachDB backup and recovery
brief: Validate full and incremental backup coverage and restore scope. Restore the intended history, close source writes, and reconcile a later valid booking by identity, capacity and external effects without consuming capacity twice.

neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns general recovery and reconciliation method.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns a whole application write handover.
